'''''Pseudodictamnus hirsutus''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Lamiaceae]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pseudodictamnus hirsutus (Willd.) Salmaki & Siadati {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:77191007-1 |access-date=2022-06-03 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> It is native to the western [[Mediterranean]] region, mostly abundant in Spain and Portugal.  It is also native to North Africa.
